title: check-half-states: H22's pinned closed-update divisor has no staleness alarm (H8 has one for its rate premise) — the board now runs 1.7–2.2× the 2026-08-31 pin
body:
Promoted by the skills seat from flight N's `noted, not filed` item at PR #16391's ACCEPT.

## The reading

`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` pins `MEASURED_CLOSED_ISSUE_UPDATES_PER_DAY = 188.3` (measured 2026-08-31) as the divisor behind H22's closed-card page budget. Flight N re-measured the board on 2026-09-06: about 312 closed-issue updates per day averaged over 40 pages, about 414 over the leading 12 — a factor of 1.66 to 2.2 above the pin. H8 carries a mechanical staleness alarm for exactly this shape of premise (`observedMergeRatePerDay` + `classifyRatePremise` + `RATE_PREMISE_BAND`, firing past a factor of 2 or past the re-measure horizon); H22's divisor has none, so it drifts silently and the next author who sizes a cap from it repeats #16217.

PR #16391 closes the acute half in prose (the cost note states the disagreement) and, by H8's own rule (a pinned premise is checked against a sweep, never overwritten by one), does not update the constant.

## What

Apply H8's alarm to H22's divisor: the sweep measures the observed closed-issue update rate from the pages it read anyway, classifies the pinned premise against it with the same band and re-measure horizon, and reports the drift in the census clause; a self-test pins the in-band, out-of-band and horizon-expired shapes. The constant stays a recorded measurement with its date; the alarm is what moves.

## Acceptance

- `check-half-states --self-test` exit 0 with the new cases named; `check-clause2-carriers --self-test`; `check-governed-merges --test` exit 0 (not governed); whole-repo lint.
- One live read-only sweep quoting the new clause on both boards.

## Serial

After PR #16391 merges (the same file and leg).

Refs #16217.
